label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
Sizwe, first things first: **leave the key out and don’t crank it again.** Every time it turns over, that pump is running on petrol without the lubrication it needs.

And please don’t top it up with diesel or try drive it. Kobus means well, but that’s old Land Rover advice. Your modern common-rail system won’t thank you, and the petrol is still in there.

Because it ran, stalled and was cranked again, there *could* be damage to the pump and injectors. That doesn’t mean the engine is finished or that you’re definitely in for R40 000. We need to inspect the pump and injectors first. If they’re okay, draining the tank, flushing the lines, fitting a new fuel filter and bleeding the system usually comes to around R2 500–R4 500. I can’t promise you a total tonight without seeing it.

Get it **towed, not driven**. Check your insurance policy for roadside assistance before paying a tow guy cash. My shop’s in Umbilo, open Saturday 7 to 12, and Thabo can drain it first thing once we’ve checked it over.

For what it’s worth, in my first year as an apprentice in 1995, I put diesel in the boss’s Golf. He still tells that story at every braai. We also had a customer do the wrong fuel twice in one year at the same garage. Made him a sticker for the fuel flap.

Borrow a bakkie for the sound system and cake anyway, boet. Don’t plan the wedding around a drained tank.

Congratulations on the wedding! Now put that key somewhere you can’t fiddle with it and get yourself home.
